facts.business: Ecoboard Industries Ltd manufactures and exports particle boards from agricultural residues and provides turnkey solutions for biogas recovery, bio-energy generation, effluent treatment, and compressed bio-gas plants through its EcoBuild, EcoEnergy, and EcoLife divisions.

capacity_or_capex.item: New 8 ft × 4 ft production line at Velapur manufacturing facility
Capital expenditure from preferential issue proceeds

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management expects increasing opportunities arising from Government initiatives promoting renewable energy, circular economy, biofuels, carbon neutrality and environmentally sustainable construction materials
